Game Overview

In City Encounter, the core idea is straightforward: hold the line as a lone officer in City Encounter, a gripping 2D defense game. Use strategy and limited resources to fend off relentless waves of criminals, upgrade your arsenal, and outlast the chaos. Can you protect the city from devastation and emerge victorious against all odds?
